Name: Penny 2 Heart Edit- George Can do it Himself (SVE Compatible)
Author: thelittlefae
Description:
[color=#f4f4f4]We're now (hopefully) compatible with SVE, Vanilla, and either version of Dusty Overhaul. Free George and Dusty.

[/color]I changed George to be a little more (rightfully) upset about the situation, penny to be more apologetic and dang-it George had been in that wheelchair a long time, he has learned to adapt and has a way to do things by himself. He isn't frail and he has his own reach extender!


[color=#f4f4f4]This all started because [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10820]this mod by [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26509849]JocelynCade[/url] isn't compatible for SVE. This mod contains no assets/dial ogue from it, but the idea comes from there.
